{{Short description|Italian mathematician and cosmographer}}
[[File:Marchetti_-_Natura_della_proporzione_e_della_proporzionalita_con_nuovo,_facile_e_sicuro_metodo,_1695_-_4260143.tif|thumb|''La natura della proporzione'', 1695]]

'''Angelo Marchetti''' (1674 – 1753) was an [[Italians|Italian]] [[mathematician]] and [[Cosmography|cosmographer]] from [[Pistoia]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://thesaurus.cerl.org/record/cnp00951386|title=Marchetti, Angelo|publisher=[[CERL Thesaurus]]}}</ref>

He was [[Alessandro Marchetti (mathematician)|Alessandro Marchetti]]'s son and a member of the [[Pontifical Academy of Arcadia|Academy of Arcadia]] in [[Rome]].<ref>{{Cite book|first=Giovanni|last=Cinelli Calvoli|author-link=Giovanni Cinelli Calvoli|title=Della biblioteca volante|location=Rome|publisher=Francesco de Lazari|date=1697|pages=23–24|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=cQnxP25XYugC&pg=PA23|language=it}}</ref>
